level_1.description: A fixed elevated camera overlooks a large marked parking lot beside a two-lane road and junction, with sidewalks, grass islands, guard booths, trees and brick buildings.

events.caption: A dark pickup drives toward the upper right and disappears behind the roadside foliage.
A gray sedan drives down and left toward the foreground and exits at the bottom edge.
A person in a pale blue top and red shorts walks slowly right along the roadside sidewalk with a dark backpack.
A light silver SUV drives from the bottom edge toward the upper right along the opposite road lane.
A cyclist in a dark top rides toward the lower left along the sidewalk and leaves the frame.
A silver minivan drives down and left along the road and stops beside the pedestrian at the curb.
A person in a pale blue top and red shorts approaches the curbside front door of a stopping silver minivan.
A dark sedan drives from the bottom edge toward the upper right along the opposite road lane.
A small white sedan drives left toward a guard booth, curves around and continues right along the far edge of the parking lot.
A person in a pale blue top pulls open the curbside front door of the silver minivan.
A person in a pale blue top and red shorts lowers into the silver minivan through its open front doorway.
A second silver SUV follows the minivan down and left toward the road junction.
The curbside front door of the silver minivan swings closed.
The silver minivan pulls away from the curb, drives toward the foreground and turns left across the bottom junction.
